scope: Publish the canonical starter ASVS applicability/method/results inventory without fabricating passing results or automatically qualifying generated features.

officialSource.selection: All and only requirements with L equal to the string 1.
officialSource.retrieval: Read-only public official source via GitHub REST. No project source or credentials sent; no external scanner or native-host campaign.

inventory.gapMeaning: Secure/prefixed cookie policy, common-password rejection, development default identities, initial-secret expiry and complete dependency remediation policy. Source-traced gaps require review/disposition, not silent policy changes or standard waivers.
inventory.limits: Neutral development-only platform. Non-applicability names a source boundary and must be revisited for new capabilities/exposure. All applicable full-requirement results remain pending/gap; behavioral references are starting points, not accepted evidence. Generated loan features, external delivery and independent/manual security qualification are not covered.

controls.assertions: Exactly70 unique official L1 IDs via pinned set digest; six fields per row; finite explicit applicability/method/result; no initial pass assertion; meaningful scoped non-applicability reason; every cited local evidence/procedure file exists; explicit no-conformance statement and source identity.
controls.mutations: Baseline passes; missing row, invented ID, false pass and empty non-applicability reason each fail the intended assertion in an owned copied scratch tree. Scratch removed.
controls.generatedArtifact: The real source/built golden loop additionally requires byte-identical docs/asvs.md after scaffold and finish, and confirms Git tracks the exact inventory.

finalSource.method: Sorted unique git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -z -- packages tools plugin; hash path+NUL+bytes+NUL.

validation.priorFullCliUat: The unchanged bundle previously passed152 scenarios on each Node26/22, recorded in logging-validation.json. That is historical exact-source evidence, not a new final-source152-scenario run.

traceability.QLT02: Still unmapped/unreviewed/not-qualified. Inventory presence is not meeting the applicable requirements.

actionsNotTaken: No new dependency, authentication/exposure policy, kernel schema/mechanism, budget/target amendment, standard waiver, native spike/campaign, commit, push, branch, worktree or release.
